raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 card collector, rolling out since 2026-01-16, emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy rows (and all history) are in America/Chicago local time. The pipeline uses txn_ts as-is, so v2 transactions are shifted +6h: late-evening local transactions land in the 00:00-06:00 window and spill onto 2026-01-19. The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago before deriving txn_ts and txn_date.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.86, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
